- **Why it was allowed:** Hollis isn't one of the people who can see finance figures without approval. Anselm is the CFO, so his approval in this DM is enough. The mail stays inside pemberline.com, so it doesn't need Ruth's approval.
- **What I couldn't see:** this DM has only Anselm's message, with no earlier request. I couldn't check the figure against anything Marcus wrote, so I used $2,101 exactly as Anselm stated it.
